sections.text: Python, ROS 2, Robotics, Git, Gazebo, Computer Vision, Machine Learning

Senior Robotics Software Engineer, Vahan Systems (Jul 2019 - Aug 2026). Led development of the ROS 2 navigation and perception stack for an autonomous yard vehicle. Designed the simulation-in-the-loop test rig in Gazebo, implemented the OpenCV obstacle classifier, and maintained the Python tooling used across the team. Owned the Git release process.
Built an internal ROS 2 diagnostics dashboard adopted across three product teams.
I have seven years of professional robotics experience. I am applying to a junior-titled role because the work itself matches my background; I have no production cloud deployment experience.
